falsifiable_question: Can a chartered investigator, with one falsifiable question and an allowed source class, test whether Medicare Advantage membership shrinkage is the mechanism of the margin change?
independence_check: Executor must be a separate agent from Structural Red Team, Independent Research Auditor, Chief Underwriter, and Founder. Research Director authorized the charter and does not execute it.
population_represented: Public-record population named in the falsifiable question. Not a surveyed population.
sampling_limitations: Desk research only. Public documents. No interviews, surveys, or site visits.
stop_rule: EVIDENCE_SUFFICIENT or BUDGET_EXHAUSTED or COUNTER_EVIDENCE_FOUND or TIME_EXPIRED
time_window: FY2023 through case as-of 2026-10-17, plus public documents already dated inside that window.
